subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: facilitate focus develop link know describe have be involve increase Many of us still (a) ⎯⎯ about metaverse. A metaverse (b) ⎯⎯ a network of 3D virtual worlds (c) ⎯⎯ on social connection. In futurism and science fiction, it often (d) ⎯⎯ as a hypothetical iteration of the Internet as a single, universal virtual world that (e) ⎯⎯ by the use of virtual and augmented reality headsets. The term ‘metaverse’ (f) ⎯⎯ its origins in the 1992 science fiction novel Snow Crash as a portmanteau of ‘meta’ and ‘universe’. Various metaverses (g) ⎯⎯ for popular use such as virtual world platforms like Second Life. Some metaverse iterations (h) ⎯⎯ integration between virtual and physical spaces and virtual economies. Demand for (i) ⎯⎯ immersion means metaverse development is often (j) ⎯⎯ to advancing virtual reality technology.
guide_solution: Right form of verbs (a) do not know (b) is (c) focused (d) is known (e) is facilitated (f) developed (g) are described (h) involve (i) increasing (j) linked
